text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text:
Decision: Add a lightweight, open-source LLM like Mistral-7B as a real-time “co-pilot” layer on top of EXCAVA’s existing rule engine. It will let the model spot subtle patterns in logs or configs that the rules miss, giving us that 0.5 % bump without rewriting the core parser.

Trade-off: We accept a small latency hit (≈50 ms per call) and the risk that the LLM occasionally “hallucinates” a fix; we’ll mitigate that by only letting it propose changes, not apply them directly.
